performance_gates.label: full_bf16x3_upload
performance_gates.note: Run66 measured a complete exact canonical bf16x3 operator representation on all 8 chips. The 0.547659 s measurement is conservative: its 943,718,400-byte timed region includes all three replicated base palettes, all three partitioned fallback streams, all three resident packed input-vector streams, and zero-initialization of the fp32 output. It improves the previous 0.62 s complete-upload evidence but still exceeds the 0.3 s budget by 0.247659 s.

performance_gates.label: correct_persistent_resident_x_fine_spmv
performance_gates.note: Run66 is the first G3-green hardware bundle: correct full bf16x3 reverse-order canonical base-palette plus exact fallback apply across all 8 Wormhole chips, with resident packed input vectors, a persistent program, and no host x/y round trip. Samples were 1.945499/1.822259/1.858679 ms (median 1.858679 ms); warmup and all samples matched the dense fp32 reference with L2 relative error 9.314343407e-7, max relative error 1.590476355e-6, max absolute error 1.525878906e-4, and no non-finite values. Run65 was an infrastructure-only Ethernet-core timeout before kernel execution and contributes no candidate timing or correctness claim.
